1: // Simple endless runner for <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
8: 
9:   // Game constants
10:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
11:   const JUMP_VEL = -12;
12:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
13:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
14:   const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
15: 
16:   let frame = 0, score = 0, gameOver = false;
17: 
18:   const player = {
19:     x: 50,
20:     y: H - PLAYER_SIZE,
21:     vy: 0,
22:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
23:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
24:     sliding: false,
25:     jump() { if (this.onGround()) this.vy = JUMP_VEL; },
26:     slide(val) { this.sliding = val; },
27:     onGround() { return this.y >= H - this.height; },
28:     update() {
29:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
30:       this.y += this.vy;
31:       if (this.y > H - this.height) { this.y = H - this.height; this.vy = 0; }
32:       // slide reduces height
33:       this.height = this.sliding ? PLAYER_SIZE / 2 : PLAYER_SIZE;
34:     },
35:     draw() {
36:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
37:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
38:     }
39:   };
40: 
41:   const obstacles = [];
42:   function spawnObstacle() {
43:     const types = ['spike', 'gap'];
44:     const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
45:     if (type === 'spike') {
46:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
47:       obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size, type: 'spike' });
48:     } else {
49:       const gapWidth = 40 + Math.random() * 40;
50:       obstacles.push({ x: W + gapWidth, y: H, w: gapWidth, h: H, type: 'gap' });
51:     }
52:   }
53: 
54:   function updateObstacles() {
55:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
56:       const o = obstacles[i];
57:       o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED;
58:       // remove off‑screen
59:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
60:     }
61:     if (frame % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
62:   }
63: 
64:   function drawObstacles() {
65:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
66:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
67:       if (o.type === 'spike') ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
68:       // gap is just empty space, nothing to draw
69:     });
70:   }
71: 
72:   function checkCollision() {
73:     for (const o of obstacles) {
74:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
75:         if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.width > o.x &&
76:             player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.height > o.y) {
77:           return true;
78:         }
79:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
80:         // gap triggers if player steps into its horizontal range and is on ground
81:         if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.width > o.x && player.onGround()) {
82:           return true;
83:         }
84:       }
85:     }
86:     return false;
87:   }
88: 
89:   function loop() {
90:     if (gameOver) {
91:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
92:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
93:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
94:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
95:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2-80, H/2);
96:       ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, W/2-70, H/2+40);
97:       return;
98:     }
99:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
100:     player.update();
101:     updateObstacles();
102:     player.draw();
103:     drawObstacles();
104:     if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
105:     score = Math.floor(frame / 10);
106:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
107:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 30);
108:     frame++;
109:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
110:   }
111: 
112:   // Input handling
113:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
114:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
115:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(true);
116:   });
117:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
118:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(false);
119:   });
120: 
121:   loop();
122: })();
